vintage: CBO baseline budget projections, February 2026 (annual only)
basis: Cumulative unified federal deficit, fiscal year to date; positive is a deficit

sources.title: 10-Year Budget Projections (February 2026 vintage)
sources.attribution: Source: Congressional Budget Office, via the CBO open data repository (US-CBO/cbo-data).

notes: No monthly profile is available. CBO and OMB publish only annual (fiscal-year) deficit projections, with no month-by-month path, so there is no official benchmark for year-to-date results.
CBO's Monthly Budget Review compares year-to-date results with the prior year, not with a projection. This dashboard does not divide an annual projection across months.

The fiscal year shown is the one containing the latest Monthly Treasury Statement month (September 2026); "2025-26" is FY2026. CBO's open-data repository gives the month of each baseline but not the day.
